history.prior_policy: Only previous-frame frozen T1 state prepared before current update; no grown pixel feedback. Strong current never vetoed. Weak requires valid shaft, age<=3, angle/normaldistance/width compatible. No history in static.

tip.policy: Always attempt for unique qualified seed, even no new pixels. Require center plus flank coherent terminal RGB boundary, current outer-width closure, nonblue background beyond, no original fiber continuation. Search/area/weak-history stop is unknown; stone contact occlusion, border out_of_view, internal transition never tip. Only reliably oriented distal branch may export tip xy. No hidden cap filling.

t1.role: Previous valid raw-probability T1 state compatibility veto for weak-side only; run/update frozen T1 on original probability every video frame even no seed; reset per video and after warmup

mask_policy: All actual raw outputs immutable. Baseline union exact. Extra blue_body_only control removes ONLY original root-connected semanticfiber and replaces it by current RGB body; other original disconnected fiber retained, stone immutable. Sides/cap same replacement, evidence-supported tiny boundary fringe allowed, no hidden gap or extrapolation. Pixel TP loss/FP remain diagnostic, not new acceptance gates.
stop: Four fixed arms; all10776frames even failed. No validation sweeps, FP/Precision or historical Dice gates this round. Final contour_sides_cap prespecified; geometry, visibility and runtime separate. Research only, no model/default/training changes.

connected_blue.seed_policy: Exact frozen aggressive seed qualification, local same-frame color/background and fixed oriented axis; unique qualified instance required. No GT or history pixel filling.
connected_blue.color_policy: Exact aggressive broad color score, no brightness or network P gate outside seed. Full visible RGB component inside forward cone; original stone barrier before connectivity. No dilation, closing, hole filling, width ratio, curvature, section stepping or seed-width extension limit.

regularization.policy: Gaussian binary occupancy smoothing then intersect original reachable blue body; protect colored highP core, retain its4CC. New output subset union; original semantic fiber and stone immutable. No new cap pixel, extrapolation, bridging or enforced taper.

tip.policy: Distal frontier of actual RGB component; require current terminal gradient+local contour closure+known nonblue background. RGB continuation/internal transition, original stone contact, unknown noise, spatial scope/safety rejection => no xy. Coordinate on current visible cap only. No independent tip GT => accuracy null.

focus.interval_policy: All59frames, no selection. Reference frames only quantitative accuracy; unlabelled frames mechanism/visualization only.

historical_reference_quality.video_static_role: diagnostic only, no choosing between modes after results

outline.axis: PCA of full current RGB4CC body, sign fixed by trusted entry-to-center; initial mask used only identity/root association and frozen broad extraction.
outline.side_pixel_mode: fit shaft only; retain original blue distal part; fit each side separately only within its observed uncensored range; unsafe local interval retains blue, never clears growth

evidence.other_color_parameters: exact frozen aggressive broad color; only boundary distance margin relaxed inside currentRGB gradient band. No black/neutral/stone fill, root4CC required.

retention.failure: Fallback postprocessing phase to full previous visible body; never zero union or force hidden connection

cap.shape: tilted half-ellipse segment tangent-compatible with current side joins; actual endpoint no farther than observed blue distal frontier
cap.policy: No current blue continuation, stone occlusion, clipped scope, or unknown background. Positive current color transition OR weak RGB contrast on current visible arc; fit failure keeps observed blue cap. No Gaussian cap or unobserved extension.

evaluation.mode: independent metrics on actual raster bodies, fixed full-blue axis/common shaft-cap interval, fallback frames included; fitted-model metrics separate

geometry_quality.reference_FP_Precision_Dice: diagnostic only per explicit user revision; never gate this round or relabel truth
geometry_quality.runtime: report separately: outline additionalP95<=5ms design target; total directP95<=source interval. No default adoption requested.
